title: Paste-an-ICS, get one-tap add-to-calendar links (iPhone-safe)
user: iPhone users and people sending them invites when iOS previews an ICS file but will not import it
job: Turn an existing ICS file into reliable, one-tap calendar actions without exposing calendar contents
smallest_useful_product: A local-only static page that accepts dropped, selected, or pasted ICS, repairs common defects, lists all events, and offers Apple-compatible ICS downloads plus Google and Outlook links per event, a fixed multi-event ICS export, and QR transfer.
privacy: Calendar contents stay in the browser; no accounts, uploads, tracking, or third-party runtime services.
